ARABIC LANGUAGE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #9
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ARABIC LANGUAGE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is a paragraph? (1 mark)
   A. A group of sentences about one idea
   B. A drawing
   C. One long word
   D. A single letter

2. Which Arabic word means "fruit"? (1 mark)
   A. لَذِيذٌ
   B. يَوْمٌ
   C. إِصْبَعٌ
   D. فَاكِهَةٌ

3. What is the name of the Arabic letter ف? (1 mark)
   A. taa
   B. shiin
   C. Saad
   D. faa

4. Which Arabic sentence means "Happy birthday." (1 mark)
   A. هَلْ عِنْدَكَ حَفْلَةٌ؟
   B. عِيدٌ مُبَارَكٌ
   C. عِيدُ مِيلَادٍ سَعِيدٌ
   D. كُلَّ عَامٍ وَأَنْتُمْ بِخَيْرٍ

5. What does the Arabic sentence لِي يَدَانِ mean? (1 mark)
   A. I have two eyes.
   B. My body is strong.
   C. This is my body.
   D. I have two hands.

6. Which Arabic word means "write"? (1 mark)
   A. أَغْمِضْ عَيْنَيْكَ
   B. اُكْتُبْ
   C. افْتَحِ الْبَابَ
   D. اِلْمَسْ أَنْفَكَ

7. How is the Arabic word كَتِفٌ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. shaʿr
   B. sinn
   C. katif
   D. raʾs

8. Why should a knife be kept out of the reach of small children? (1 mark)
   A. It is old
   B. It can cause harm
   C. It is expensive
   D. It is heavy

9. What is the name of the Arabic letter و? (1 mark)
   A. Haa
   B. daal
   C. waaw
   D. siin

10. What does the Arabic sentence أُنَظِّفُ أَسْنَانِي mean? (1 mark)
   A. My hand is small.
   B. I clean my teeth.
   C. My head is big.
   D. I wash my face.

11. What does the Arabic word يَدٌ (yad) mean? (1 mark)
   A. stomach
   B. hand
   C. tooth
   D. mouth

12. Which sound does the Arabic letter ف make? (1 mark)
   A. t as in tap
   B. th as in think
   C. m as in mat
   D. f as in fan

13. In which direction is Arabic read? (1 mark)
   A. From the middle
   B. From right to left
   C. From top to bottom only
   D. From left to right

14. Which Arabic word means "grandfather"? (1 mark)
   A. أَبٌ
   B. أُسْرَةٌ
   C. جَدٌّ
   D. جَدَّةٌ

15. Which line of the poem means 'My nose smells'? (1 mark)
   A. anfii yashummu
   B. ʿaynii taraa
   C. famii yatakallamu
   D. udhunii tasmaʿu

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Write five things or rooms found in a home in Arabic (English letters are fine) with their meanings. (5 marks) (5 marks)

17. Explain why your family members are important to you. Give two examples of roles. (3 marks) (3 marks)

18. Translate into English: haadhihi yadii (2 marks)

19. Read the sentence هَذِهِ أُمِّي and give its meaning. Say which family word it contains. (3 marks) (3 marks)

20. Translate into English: hadiyya li-Aminata (2 marks)
pages.answers:
ARABIC LANGUAGE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #9 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — A group of sentences about one idea
   A paragraph is a group of related sentences about one idea.

2. D — فَاكِهَةٌ
   فَاكِهَةٌ (faakiha) means fruit.

3. D — faa
   The letter ف is called faa.

4. C — عِيدُ مِيلَادٍ سَعِيدٌ
   عِيدُ مِيلَادٍ سَعِيدٌ (ʿiid miilaad saʿiid) means: Happy birthday.

5. D — I have two hands.
   لِي يَدَانِ (lii yadaani) means: I have two hands.

6. B — اُكْتُبْ
   اُكْتُبْ (uktub) means write.

7. C — katif
   كَتِفٌ is read katif and means shoulder.

8. B — It can cause harm
   Sharp items can hurt small children.

9. C — waaw
   The letter و is called waaw.

10. B — I clean my teeth.
   أُنَظِّفُ أَسْنَانِي (unadhdhifu asnaanii) means: I clean my teeth.

11. B — hand
   يَدٌ (yad) means hand.

12. D — f as in fan
   The letter ف makes the sound f as in fan.

13. B — From right to left
   Arabic is read from right to left.

14. C — جَدٌّ
   جَدٌّ (jadd) means grandfather.

15. A — anfii yashummu
   anf is nose and yashummu means smells.

SECTION B
----
16. (5 marks)
   Answer: For example bayt (house), ghurfa (room), matbakh (kitchen), hammaam (bathroom), hadiiqa (garden).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct word with its meaning.

17. (3 marks)
   Answer: They love and care for us. For example parents work, cook and pay for school; grandparents share stories and advice; children help at home.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for love and care, 2 marks for two correct roles.

18. (2 marks)
   Answer: This is my hand.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

19. (3 marks)
   Answer: haadhihi ummii. This is my mother. It contains umm (mother).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for reading, 1 mark for meaning and 1 mark for the family word.

20. (2 marks)
   Answer: A gift for Amina.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.
